correctness.rationale: Proof explicitly separates factors spanning multiple inflated letters (copy a strict cut-spanning seed occurrence), factors inside a single inflated letter (middle-pair induction via bijection (c,d)→(1−c,d)), and singletons (all four bigrams force both letters at selected positions). Base k=0 is valid and every quantifier is uniform. A superficially similar but weaker position-only attractor condition was rejected and not assumed. Standalone finite tests corroborate two distinct seeds; no finite test is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A mathematically natural and reusable finite certificate controls infinitely many iterated morphic images with no increase in attractor cardinality. The proof identifies two different mechanisms for long factors and short in-block factors, and applies to arbitrary seeds independent of a chosen fixed point. The mechanism is structural rather than a number-only recomputation, and gives explicit size-four attractors for noncanonical seed words including 00110. No minimum/equality is asserted.
